headline: Supreme Court Ruling Cancels Gibran Rakabuming Raka Diploma Decree
seoTitle: Supreme Court Rules On Gibran Rakabuming Raka Diploma Decree
metaDescription: The Supreme Court of Indonesia has issued a final ruling cancelling the equivalence decree for the high school diploma of Vice President Gibran.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian Supreme Court has released ruling number 742 K/TUN/2026, which formally cancels the high school diploma equivalence decree of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The court stated there is no evidence verifying the vice president holds an overseas educational certificate equivalent to a high school diploma.
Legal experts and officials note that the Supreme Court ruling is final, precluding further legal challenges such as a case review (PK).
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Supreme Court has officially published its full verdict regarding a cassation appeal, resulting in the cancellation of the high school diploma equivalence letter previously issued for Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka. The court concluded that there was insufficient evidence to prove the existence of an equivalent overseas diploma. Following the publication of the ruling, the court has directed the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education to revoke the certificate. While some parties have discussed potential legal responses to the decision, constitutional law experts have emphasized that the Supreme Court's ruling is final and binding, meaning it cannot be overturned through further legal action such as a case review. This judicial development follows ongoing public and legal scrutiny regarding the validity of the vice president's educational credentials, with the court's decision now formalizing the status of the contested equivalence document.
whyItIsViral: The story has generated significant media coverage across multiple major Indonesian outlets due to the involvement of the vice president and the final, binding nature of the judicial ruling.
